name: workmailmessageflow
description: The WorkMail Message Flow API provides access to email messages as they are being sent and received by a WorkMail organization

subcommands.name: get-raw-message-content
subcommands.description: Retrieves the raw content of an in-transit email message, in MIME format

options.name: --message-id
options.description: The identifier of the email message to retrieve

options.name: outfile
options.description: Filename where the content will be saved

subcommands.name: put-raw-message-content
subcommands.description: Updates the raw content of an in-transit email message, in MIME format.

options.name: --message-id
options.description: The identifier of the email message being updated

options.name: --content
options.description: Describes the raw message content of the updated email message

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
